column3: “Pouring out a libation” is rendered “make an alliance.”
“They a sitting still” is rendered “Rahab who has been exterminated,” following a different reading.
“For ever until perpetuity” is rendered “As a witness forever,” following a different vowel reading.
“The seers … the seers” is rendered “the seers … the prophets,” and “see deceptions” as “Prophesy illusions.”
“Is rising up” is rendered “waits on high,” and “is waiting” as “longs.”
“Teachers” (plural) is rendered “Teacher,” capitalized, and NASB adds “Although.”
“Make unclean” is rendered “defile,” and “throw away” as “scatter”; “filth” as “Be gone!”
“Heaviness of lifting up” is rendered “dense is His smoke.”
“A sieve of worthlessness” is rendered “a sieve,” and “leads astray” as “leads to ruin.”
“The majesty of His voice” is rendered “His voice of authority,” and “driving storm and rainstorm” as “cloudburst, downpour.”
